integrity: The proof first characterizes metric bases of the balanced spider, then derives the exact domination obstruction on an omitted arm and a matching family of constructions. The minimum-set count follows from the depth threshold on metric bases. A standalone checker independently reconstructs all distances and tests the defining properties.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to balanced spiders with at least three arms and common arm length at least two.
Covers only the regime k >= ceil(L/2); the smaller-radius regime is not claimed.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= q <= 5 and 2 <= L <= 5 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed treatment of the same balanced-spider specialization.
title: Sharp large-radius transition for distance-\(k\) resolving domination of balanced spiders
